name: build-orchestrator help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-orchestrator. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Only
entries.text: Shows only this kind.

entries.title: Keep
entries.text: Keeps this step in the build.

entries.title: Add note
entries.text: Adds a note to this build, for you or the next session.

entries.title: Save rules
entries.text: Saves the token rules every session follows.

entries.title: Hidden
entries.text: Builds you hid from the list. Tap to see them.

entries.title: Approve upgrade
entries.text: Approves raising the next phase to a stronger model (Opus to Fable). Only Brett's own click counts; a downgrade needs no approval.

entries.title: Approve upgrade
entries.text: Approves the waiting model upgrade request for this phase. Only Brett's own click counts; it is recorded with his name.

entries.title: Package builds
entries.text: Opens the Package builds window: every step still waiting to be built, Fable by default. Tick the ones you want, put them in order, and combine them into one build.

entries.title: Package the Fable work
entries.text: Opens Package builds with every waiting Fable step already ticked and Send to helper picked. Untick any of them; nothing is sent until you confirm the list.

entries.title: Package more
entries.text: Starts another package from the steps still waiting.

entries.title: Thinking
entries.text: How hard the model thinks: low, medium, high or max. Filters the list, or sets the package's thinking level.

entries.title: Area
entries.text: Shows only steps that touch this part of the code (a plugin, an app, the kernel, the spec).

entries.title: Select none
entries.text: Unticks every step in view.

entries.title: Invert
entries.text: Ticks what is unticked in view and unticks what is ticked.

entries.title: All Fable work
entries.text: Ticks every waiting Fable step and picks Send to helper, do it now. It only pre-ticks: untick anything, and you confirm the list before it goes.

entries.title: Send to helper
entries.text: The package goes to a helper session (Session sync) as one offer. Do it now puts it at the top of that helper's list.

entries.title: Add to my orchestrator
entries.text: The package becomes its own build in your orchestrator, at the queue position you pick.

entries.title: Helper
entries.text: Which helper session gets the package. Any free helper lets the orchestrator pick.

entries.title: Do it now
entries.text: Top priority on that helper: it starts on this package before anything else on its list.

entries.title: Queue position
entries.text: Where the package goes in your build queue: the top, a position, or the end.

entries.title: Review ticked steps
entries.text: Shows exactly what will be packaged, in order, so you can confirm it before anything is made or sent.

entries.title: Bring the prerequisites along
entries.text: Adds the earlier steps the ticked ones need (from the same builds) to the package, in front of them.

entries.title: Package builds
entries.text: Opens the Package builds window: pick waiting steps (Fable by default) and combine them into one build.

entries.title: Send to helper now
entries.text: Offers this package to a helper session as top priority, then re-checks the build order.

entries.title: Unpackage
entries.text: Puts this package's steps back in their own builds and removes the package. Only while none of its steps are done.

entries.title: Optimize builds…
entries.text: Repacks every waiting step into the fewest builds. You see the new builds and every step before anything changes.

entries.title: Build optimizer
entries.text: How Optimize builds works: mode, packing caps, grouping rules, safety, presets, schedule and notifications.

entries.title: Optimizer notifications
entries.text: When the optimizer tells you which mode ran: only when AI wasn't available, every run, or never.

entries.title: Filters
entries.text: Shows the filters that pick which waiting steps the optimizer may repack.

entries.title: Fable candidates
entries.text: Only steps on Fable, or steps the audit says should be on Fable.

entries.title: Undo last
entries.text: Undoes the last optimizer run or step move: its new builds go and every build it changed comes back.

entries.title: Older than (days)
entries.text: Only builds at least this many days old.

entries.title: Newer than (days)
entries.text: Only builds at most this many days old. 0 means any age.

entries.title: Run Deep
entries.text: Runs Deep mode: the AI reads the briefs, steps and code, then repacks. Its tokens are booked to the agent shown.

entries.title: Use Basic
entries.text: Runs the plain-code optimizer instead: no AI, no tokens.

entries.title: Use it
entries.text: Takes the AI's suggested name for this build.

entries.title: Drag step
entries.text: Drag this step to another build in the plan. Click to pick several and drag them together.

entries.title: Apply
entries.text: Makes the new builds, moves the steps over and archives the emptied builds, all at once. One undo puts it back.

entries.title: Optimize builds…
entries.text: Opens the optimizer: it repacks waiting steps into fewer builds and shows you the result to confirm.

entries.title: Deep mode model
entries.text: The model Deep mode asks for its review.

entries.title: Deep mode thinking
entries.text: How hard Deep mode thinks.

entries.title: Token budget per run
entries.text: A Deep run over this many tokens runs as Basic instead. 0 means no cap.

entries.title: Book Deep runs to agent
entries.text: The crew agent whose card gets the Deep run's tokens.

entries.title: Max steps per build
entries.text: The most steps a combined build may hold.

entries.title: Max hours per build
entries.text: The most estimated work a combined build may hold.

entries.title: Max builds in the result
entries.text: Warns when the plan needs more builds than this. 0 means no cap.

entries.title: Fewest builds
entries.text: Packs as much as fits into each build.

entries.title: Balanced across slots
entries.text: Spreads the work evenly over the builds that can run at once.

entries.title: Fastest finish
entries.text: Only combines related work, so unrelated builds can run side by side.

entries.title: Slots
entries.text: How many builds run at once, for Balanced.

entries.title: Overhead per build
entries.text: Minutes each build costs on top of its steps (start, PR, CI, screenshots). Used for the time saved.

entries.title: Weight
entries.text: How strongly this rule pulls steps into the same build.

entries.title: Never touch running steps
entries.text: The step a build is working on never moves. Always on.

entries.title: Respect pins
entries.text: Pinned builds are never repacked.

entries.title: Pull from running builds
entries.text: Lets the optimizer move a running build's steps that haven't started. Off keeps running builds whole.

entries.title: Always confirm
entries.text: Nothing is applied until you confirm it. Always on.

entries.title: Pinned builds
entries.text: Build ids the optimizer leaves alone, separated by commas.

entries.title: Flag only
entries.text: Steps that look already built or duplicated get a flag; they stay ticked.

entries.title: Untick in the dialog
entries.text: Steps that look already built or duplicated start unticked, so they stay where they are unless you tick them.

entries.title: Most common
entries.text: A combined build takes the category most of its steps have.

entries.title: First step's
entries.text: A combined build takes its first step's category.

entries.title: Fixed
entries.text: Every combined build gets the category below.

entries.title: Fixed category
entries.text: The category every combined build gets.

entries.title: Manual only
entries.text: The optimizer only runs when you ask.

entries.title: After every new build
entries.text: Makes a plan after a build is added and tells you. Nothing changes until you confirm.

entries.title: Nightly
entries.text: Makes a plan once a night and tells you. Nothing changes until you confirm.

entries.title: Save these settings as
entries.text: Name for a preset that keeps these settings and the saved filter.

entries.title: Move prerequisites too
entries.text: Moves the steps this one needs along with it, in order.

entries.title: Move only
entries.text: Moves just the dragged steps. The steps they need stay behind.

entries.title: Drag step
entries.text: Drag this step onto any build's step list, here or in another tab or window. Shift- or ctrl-click to pick several.
